recipe.title: Grape and blackberry crumble
recipe.intro: Early August brings sweet grapes from Europe and the first hedgerow blackberries. Baked together they turn jammy and deep purple under a crisp oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional).
Tip the grapes and blackberries into a baking dish. Add the lemon zest and juice, the cornflour and 1 tbsp of the sugar, then toss until the fruit is lightly coated.
In a bowl, mix the flour, oats, cinnamon, salt and the rest of the sugar.
Pour in the oil and water and rub together with your fingertips until the mixture forms damp clumps, a bit like wet sand with pebbles in it.
Scatter the topping evenly over the fruit without pressing it down, so it stays crisp.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is golden and purple juice is bubbling up at the edges.
Leave to stand for 5 minutes so the juices thicken a little, then spoon into bowls.
recipe.tip: Leftovers keep covered in the fridge for 3 days and are lovely cold for breakfast, or swap the blackberries for sliced plums later in the month.
